measure_denominator: documented scope note excluding shadow deployment / 1
justification: Current authority is public-source only; scope drift would breach governance.
green_proceed: Scope note recorded before pilot start.
amber_modify: Minor wording ambiguity only; no operational work included.
red_stop: Any pilot step includes partner, live-target, nonpublic, or disclosure activity.

measure_denominator: pilot sources with lawful-use path / pilot sources
justification: No definitive work is defensible without explicit source-rights decisions.
green_proceed: Every pilot source has an explicit lawful-use path or metadata-only fallback.
amber_modify: A noncritical source remains pending but can be replaced without changing the pilot aim.
red_stop: Any critical source lacks a lawful path.

measure_denominator: pilot cases with all critical manifest fields / pilot cases
justification: The benchmark-core claim depends on case-level auditability.
green_proceed: All critical fields are completed without post-cutoff leakage.
amber_modify: Recoverable gaps remain but field rules are clear.
red_stop: Any critical field is unavailable lawfully or requires ad hoc future information.

measure_denominator: rerun cases with unchanged split eligibility / rerun cases
justification: Independence controls must be auditable, not one-off judgments.
green_proceed: Independent rerun leaves split eligibility unchanged for all rerun cases.
amber_modify: Disagreements are local and fully resolvable by rule refinement.
red_stop: Unresolved disagreement changes eligibility for any rerun case.

measure_denominator: clean reruns of source+bytecode normalization / planned reruns
justification: Clone control is central to the interaction claim.
green_proceed: Pipeline reruns cleanly with documented versions.
amber_modify: Rerun works only after minor tooling clarification.

measure_denominator: pilot examples assigned without ad hoc exceptions / pilot examples
justification: Exploit-family and censor-aware claims need explicit rules.
green_proceed: All pilot examples receive auditable mechanism and status assignments.
amber_modify: A bounded subset requires rule refinement.
red_stop: Assignments remain subjective or contradictory after rule review.

measure_denominator: reproduced baseline stages / planned baseline stages
justification: Performance-survival comparisons require a frozen comparator.
amber_modify: Reproduction works only after documented adjustments.
red_stop: No public baseline can be reproduced or justified.

measure_denominator: pilot tasks with known feasible cost/access path / pilot tasks
justification: Hidden access or cost failures can invalidate the program early.
green_proceed: All pilot tasks fit current public-data resources.
amber_modify: Some costs or access paths remain uncertain but bounded.
red_stop: Critical access requires unknown or unacceptable cost or terms.

justification: Operational claims are unsafe without governance, adjudication, and partner authority.
green_proceed: Written authority, partner, adjudicator, and follow-up package exist.
amber_modify: Some prerequisites are in progress but extension remains frozen.
